note: Links from every requirement to what builds it and what proves it. An endpoint is 'VERB /path' of docs/openapi.json, or it is marked internal. A service is an id of docs/services.json (or 'gateway' for the planner logic inside the gateway).

NFR-01.evidence: measure-apis.js times the three outside APIs: the slowest p95 (1260 ms) plus 500 ms of our own work is 1760 ms.

NFR-02.evidence: An integration test makes each outside API fail in turn and expects the decision needs-review.

NFR-03.evidence: A unit test with a fake fetch that always fails counts the attempts: at most 3.

NFR-04.evidence: A test scans the source files for key patterns; each endpoint test sends one bad input and expects 400.

NFR-05.evidence: A test rejects codes such as BR-03 in the reasons, and the Student Affairs officer reads the reasons of the seven seed requests.

NFR-06.evidence: A contract test checks the content type, the date format and the currency code of each response.

NFR-07.evidence: verify.js lists the endpoints of the OpenAPI file and looks for a tagged test of each.

NFR-08.evidence: A load test sends 20 requests in one minute to a planner with fake outside services.
